rendered: The Mn-substituted LNO cathode with 10%[1] Mn delivers 212 mAh g^− 1[2], and the cathode with 50%[3] Mn delivers 164 mAh g^− 1[4]. The text discussing the results in the figure says that increasing the Mn content improves cycling stability at the expense of these capacities, owing to the electrochemical inactivity of Mn ions.
